event.firm_key: DAVIS CHOCOLATE A DIVISION OF DECO CHEM INC
event.recalling_firm: Davis Chocolate a division of Deco Chem, Inc.

products.product_description: Davis Chocolate Peanut Morsels /Organic Peanut Chips
products.product_quantity: 2840 lbs of lot GMPBMO-25 and 1960 lbs of lot GMPBMO-26
products.code_info: Production Information: Davis Chocolate Peanut Morsels lot GMPBMO-25/FTORK-DCPC-13 was produced starting February 8, 2018 and finishing on February 14, 2018. Lot GMPBMO-26/FTORK-DCPC-14 had production dates of February 15-23, 2018.
products.reason_for_recall: Davis Chocolate Inc., voluntarily removed organic peanut butter chips from a wholesale account due to a customer's laboratory analysis of the product indicating the presence of Listeria monocytogenes.
